newsitem.title: USA: Universal Studios to buy film distributor - report.
newsitem.headline: Universal Studios to buy film distributor - report.

text.p: Universal Studios has agreed in principle to acquire privately-held movie distributor October Films, Daily Variety reported Friday.
The trade paper, quoting "sources" and "insiders" for its report, said the purchase price was not disclosed but was less than October Films's estimated value of $40 million.
It said the structure of the deal was based on the future performance of October Films, which had success recently with the Oscar-nominated films "Breaking the Waves" and "Secrets & Lies."
Universal is part of Seagram Co Ltd's MCA Inc subsidiary.
